items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Erskine Hawkins. It didn't catch on as much as Jacquet's did

ctx.x: Erskine Hawkins. It didn't catch on as much as Jacquet's did, but he did that and a cat asked me once, why did Texas players have the big sounds, most of them? So I told him once, the way I could answer, I said, 'Well, there's a big stage. You got to play loud to be heard.' (Laughter.) And it stuck. You know, they made a joke out of it. But actually, I don't know. I think it's guys being impressed by some -- like a guy leaves from Texas and he makes it. Well, everybody, you know, they -- I think it's from things…
